title: Measuring Dynamic Diffraction for Quantitative HREM
content: Dynamic diffraction (DD) contributes significant contrast to lattice images complicating their interpretations. They add unknown phase shifts and are the bane of quantitative imaging of crystals. Measuring DD by scattering amplitudes is inadequate. Phase measurement would be better especially if it could be done at the atomic scale. DD is especially complex in strong scattering specimens. Required is an atomic resolution measurement of DD’s phase in HREM images to help with the interpretation of fine image features possible by DD’s removal. This paper presents a method for measuring and possibly removing DD.
